scientific_integrity: Original claim is the explicit all-length three-marker sharp read threshold and chirality formula; no claim of inventing generic circular-string reconstruction, shortest-path graph assembly, or multiset spectrum models.
scientific_limitations: Exact noiseless complete oriented cyclic k-substring multispectra; length and Hamming weight three known. No conclusion for missing/noisy reads or larger weights. Literature equivalence risk remains; no independent validation.
title: Sharp read-length reconstruction of binary three-marker necklaces
